{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. '1768629721000') instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so the TIMESTAMP cast fails. 1768629721 s is 2026-01-17 06:02:01 UTC, which matches the 06:00 start pattern of other batches and batch 13's ingest on Jan 18. So the values are UTC epoch ms and can be converted safely.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(txn_ts), '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM parsed;"}}
